title: FireChat
description: FireChat is a universal plugin for setting up a chat manager on Minecraft servers.
body:
**FireChat is a versatile chat plugin for Minecraft servers. Customize a stylish chat with HEX colors, gradients, link filtering, mute system, and auto-messages. Suitable for any server, from cozy communities to large-scale projects.
Key Features**

> Chat Customization: Format global and local chats with HEX colors and gradients (e.g.,   
> <gradient:#FF6B6B:#FFE66D>%player%</gradient>).  
> Global and Local Chat: Switch between modes using symbols (! for global) or commands (/firechat global, /firechat local). Global chat is logged; local chat is not.  
> Mute System: Manage mutes with /mute and /unmute commands, featuring auto-cleanup and persistence.  
> Link Filtering:  
```
none: Filtering disabled, all links allowed.  
all: All links sent in chat are blocked.  
blacklist: Only links with domains listed in url-filters in config.yml (e.g., example.com,) are blocked.  
whitelist: Only links with domains listed in url-filters are allowed; all others are blocked.
```
> _Auto-Messages: Customizable messages with gradients and set intervals.  
> Local Chat Radius: Adjust the radius via /firechat radius or config.  
> Multilingual Support: Supports Russian, Ukrainian, English, and custom languages.  
> PlaceholderAPI Support: Integration with placeholders (e.g., %luckperms_prefix%).  
> Flexible Permissions: Permissions for players and administrators._

> What Makes FireChat Special?
> > FireChat transforms your server’s chat into a unique communication space. Vibrant gradients and HEX colors create a modern style, while link filtering and the mute system ensure safety and order. Integration with PlaceholderAPI and easy configuration via config.yml allow the plugin to be tailored to any need, from visual design to chat control.
> > Commands


```
/firechat <reload|global|local|radius|language> — Manage chat settings.  
/mute <player> <time> [reason] — Mute a player.  
/unmute <player> — Unmute a player.
```


Permissions
```
firechat.use — Access to use the chat (default: true for all).  
firechat.reload — Reload the plugin configuration (default: op).  
firechat.radius — Change the local chat radius (default: op).  
firechat.language — Change the plugin’s language (default: op).  
firechat.bypass.url — Bypass link filtering (default: op).  
firechat.bypass.mute — Bypass the mute system (default: op).  
firechat.mute — Use /mute and /unmute commands (default: op).  
firechat.staff.notify — Receive notifications about mutes (default: op).  
firechat.* — Access to all FireChat permissions.
```


Compatibility

- Minecraft: 1.16.5 – 1.21.10.  
- Cores: Paper, Spigot, Purpur.  
- Java: 11 – 21.  
- Softdepend: PlaceholderAPI for placeholder support.

Support
Found a bug? Contact us on Telegram: @GraunGamesTeam. We value your feedback and work quickly to improve the plugin!
